tool_signatures.name: create_icon
tool_signatures.description: Create an Apple Icon Composer .icon bundle from a foreground image and background color. Outputs a ready-to-use .icon bundle for Xcode 26.

foreground_path.description: Absolute path to foreground image (PNG or SVG)

output_dir.description: Directory to write the .icon bundle to

dark_bg_color.description: Dark mode background color as hex

glyph_scale.description: Scale of foreground glyph (0.1-2.0, default 1.0 fills ~65% of icon area in Icon Composer)

blur_material.description: Liquid Glass blur amount (0-1, omit to disable)

split_layers.description: Split multi-shape SVGs into separate glass layers (each shape gets independent glass effects)

tool_signatures.name: export_marketing
tool_signatures.description: Export a flat marketing PNG for App Store Connect. No Liquid Glass effects, no alpha channel. Produces a 1024x1024 (default) opaque PNG ready for upload.

output_path.description: Output path for the PNG file

return_image.description: Return the rendered image inline as base64 (default true)
